shortDescription: A seismic survey vessel commissioned by a consortium of US oil major Chevron NYSE:CVX and Greece's Helleniq Energy ATHEX:ELPE has arrived in the southern Ionian Sea and is expected to begin exploration work in the coming days, the Greek energy ministry said on Friday.

children: A seismic survey vessel commissioned by a consortium of US oil major Chevron
has arrived in the southern Ionian Sea and is expected to begin exploration work in the coming days, the Greek energy ministry said on Friday.
The surveys are expected to be completed by the end of January 2027.
Seismic exploration work is the first step towards assessing ⁠hydrocarbon ​potential before any decision ​can be taken on test drilling
A Chevron-led consortium also has exclusive lease agreements to lead the search for gas in three other deep-sea blocks off the Peloponnese and Crete

Greece, which has no gas production and relies on gas imports for power generation and domestic consumption, has revived its quest for gas exploration after a 2022 energy price shock driven by Russia's invasion of Ukraine
